body: An exciting idea can grow into a promise much faster than the facts underneath it are growing. When Mercury squares Jupiter, thought and expansion create friction, making exaggeration, overconfidence, and conclusions that outrun the evidence easier to slip into ordinary conversation. One encouraging result can suddenly sound like proof of an entire future. Audit the specific numbers, dates, and baseline assumptions before you let a charismatic pitch dictate your strategy. You can absolutely leverage the enthusiasm, provided you refuse to underwrite it with your own unverified risk.
